scope: Read-only assistant review of native runner inventory, required CI wiring, custody/floor qualification language, migration review and dependency declaration boundaries.
preserved_limits: 26 exact V4 selector results do not substitute for full protocol, full workspace or all hosted gates.
Before/after source equality is not continuous enforced immutability or independent executor authentication.
A complete signed ancestor floor is conditional on authenticated sufficiently fresh external retention.
Default V3 opening remains unpinned; not every effect path is forced through the V4 API.
Signed provider declarations do not prove actual effects, provider independence or current production effect authority.
A refused newer orphan notification is not accepted into an internal pending queue; the caller retains it.
Evidence hashes and distinct labels do not authenticate people, devices, key identities, proofs or lifetime populations.
Earlier failed original native campaigns remain failed at their recorded source.
